# truenas_nfs_config (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS NFS service configuration. This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one NFS configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls nfs.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place, since existing NFS exports and clients may depend on it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_nfs_config" "config" {
  protocols         = ["NFSV3", "NFSV4"]
  servers           = 8
  userd_manage_gids = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_nonroot` (Boolean) Whether NFS client mount requests from unprivileged (non-root) ports are allowed.
- `bindip` (List of String) IP addresses to bind the NFS service to. Empty list binds to all addresses.
- `mountd_log` (Boolean) Whether mountd logging is enabled.
- `mountd_port` (Number) TCP/UDP port used by mountd. A value of 0 restores the default (dynamic) port.
- `protocols` (List of String) NFS protocol versions to serve. One or more of NFSV3, NFSV4.
- `rdma` (Boolean) Whether NFS over RDMA is enabled.
- `rpclockd_port` (Number) TCP/UDP port used by rpc.lockd. A value of 0 restores the default (dynamic) port.
- `rpcstatd_port` (Number) TCP/UDP port used by rpc.statd. A value of 0 restores the default (dynamic) port.
- `servers` (Number) Number of NFS server threads. A value of 0 restores automatic thread management.
- `statd_lockd_log` (Boolean) Whether rpc.statd and rpc.lockd logging is enabled.
- `userd_manage_gids` (Boolean) Whether supplemental groups are resolved server-side (more than 16 groups).
- `v4_domain` (String) NFSv4 domain override for ID mapping. Empty string uses the system default.
- `v4_krb` (Boolean) Whether Kerberos is required for NFSv4 mounts.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "nfs_config".
- `keytab_has_nfs_spn` (Boolean) Whether the system keytab currently has an NFS service principal name. Server-computed; never sent to nfs.update.
- `managed_nfsd` (Boolean) Whether the NFS server daemon is currently managed/running. Server-computed; never sent to nfs.update.
- `v4_krb_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Kerberos is currently enabled/active for NFSv4. Server-computed; never sent to nfs.update.
